rules.name: BareReference
rules.message: '%s' is only a reference. Say what changed, and keep the link after it.

rules.name: ChangeType
rules.message: '%s' isn't a change type. Use Added, Changed, Deprecated, Removed, Fixed, or Security.

rules.name: ChangeTypeAlias
rules.message: Use '%s', not '%s': it's one of the six change types.

rules.name: DateFormat
rules.message: Write the release date as YYYY-MM-DD, not '%s'.

rules.name: ReleaseHeading
rules.message: '%s' isn't a release heading. Write '[1.2.3] - YYYY-MM-DD', or '[Unreleased]'.

rules.name: RepeatedVerb
rules.message: The section heading already says it: drop '%s'.

rules.name: Vague
rules.message: '%s' says nothing a reader can act on. Name what changed.

rules.name: VersionLink
rules.message: Bracket the version so it can link to its diff: '%s' should be '%s'.

rules.name: VersionPrefix
rules.message: Drop the 'v': '%s' should be '%s'.

rules.name: Yanked
rules.message: Mark a pulled release '[YANKED]', not '%s'.
